name: fraud-agent
description: Intelligent Fraud Detection & Response Agent - Autonomously monitors financial transactions, detects anomalies using multi-signal analysis, scores risk with AI reasoning, and executes graduated response actions with full audit trails.
author: Tanvirul Islam

skills.name: detect-fraud
skills.description: Master orchestrator - runs the full fraud detection pipeline (anomaly detection → risk scoring → escalation). Use 'Run fraud detection' to execute end-to-end.

skills.name: anomaly-detector
skills.description: Scans recent transactions for velocity attacks, geo-impossible travel, amount spikes, high-risk merchants, and channel switches.

skills.name: risk-scorer
skills.description: Scores flagged transactions 0-100 with natural-language reasoning. Classifies as CLEAR/MONITOR/ALERT/CRITICAL.

skills.name: escalation-handler
skills.description: Executes graduated actions (dismiss/monitor/hold/block) based on risk scores and logs all decisions to the audit table.
